question: Which of the following statements best describes the application of oxy-fuel gas welding?

options.text: It is used for welding operations requiring high heat input.
It is primarily used for welding thick steel sections.
It generates a higher flame temperature compared to oxy-acetylene welding.
It is preferred for welding operations with lower heat requirements.

solution:
**Concept**

 
• Oxy-fuel gas welding (OFW) is a group of welding processes which produces coalescence by heating materials with an oxy-fuel gas flame.
 
• The most common fuel gas used is acetylene, which produces a flame temperature of approximately 3100^circ{C}.
 
• Compared to electric arc welding, the heat source in oxy-fuel welding is less concentrated and has a lower power density.
 
• Due to the lower heat intensity and slower heating rate, the heat-affected zone (HAZ) is typically larger in oxy-fuel welding.
